correctness.rationale: A complete equivalence reduces the distance condition to cyclically independent graph neighborhoods. The degree bound gives \( |\mathcal C|\le\lfloor n\lfloor n/2\rfloor/2\rfloor \); complete bipartite or circulant-plus-matching constructions prove equality for every \(n\ge3\), including \(n=3\). The standalone package verifier tests \(3\le n\le120\), direct pair reads through \(n=15\) and exhaustive exact optima through \(n=11\). Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of the all-length assertion.

value.rationale: Fixed Hamming-weight-two words form a natural sparse-message family in symbol-pair storage channels. The theorem determines its exact one-pair-error-correcting capacity for all lengths, and matching lower constructions resolve the odd-degree parity obstacle via an explicit step-k-cycle matching. Neither unrestricted MDS bounds nor a finite test alone supplies the new exact family. It does not claim other weights or distances.
